label: Human approval
description: Waits in FlowAction, with no runner, until a person approves or rejects. Shows what happened and what each decision leads to.

inputs.name: title
inputs.label: Title
inputs.description: What the person decides; reads process variables with {{ name.path }}

inputs.name: context
inputs.label: What happened
inputs.description: Shown above the decision; reads process variables with {{ name.path }}

inputs.name: on_approve
inputs.label: If approved
inputs.description: What happens when the person approves

inputs.name: on_reject
inputs.label: If rejected
inputs.description: What happens when the person rejects

inputs.name: approvers
inputs.label: Who can decide
inputs.description: write: people with write access (default); maintain: only maintainers and admins

outputs.name: comment
outputs.description: What the person wrote, or empty

outputs.name: decided_by
outputs.description: GitHub login of the person who decided

outputs.name: decided_at
outputs.description: When they decided, as an ISO 8601 date
